title: Elon Musk says Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to discuss a possible merger and calls the possibility of a Tesla-SpaceX merger a "good idea" (Andrew J. Hawkins/The Verge)
summary: Andrew J. Hawkins / The Verge: Elon Musk says Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to discuss a possible merger and calls the possibility of a Tesla-SpaceX merger a “good idea” — Musk called the merger “a good idea,” though it cautioned it wasn't a guarantee.
contentText:
Andrew J. Hawkins / The Verge :

Elon Musk says Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to discuss a possible merger and calls the possibility of a Tesla-SpaceX merger a “good idea”   —  Musk called the merger “a good idea,” though it cautioned it wasn't a guarantee.
